data.name: Lareeb
data.gender_notes: Lareeb is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lareeb means someone who interprets or explains things clearly. It is derived from the Arabic root 'R-B' which implies to explain or interpret. The name Lareeb carries the meaning “Interpreter or explainer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lareeb usually hope their child will grow to embody interpreter or explainer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the context of Islamic spirituality, Lareeb signifies one who helps others understand the deeper meanings of faith and life.
data.etymology: Lareeb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Interpreter or explainer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lareeb total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.long_meaning: لريب هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'لرب' الذي يعني الميل إلى الخير و اتباعه. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في الإسلام، حيث يدل على الشخص الذي يميل إلى فعل الخير و يتبع طريق الحق.

in_urdu.name: لریب
in_urdu.meaning: لریب کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اچھائی کی طرف مائل ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: لریب ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اچھائی کی طرف مائل ہوتا ہے اور اس کا پیروی کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں ایک اچھے اور محمود معنی کو دارا ہے، جو کہ اچھائی کے کام کرنے اور راستہ حق پر چلنے کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लरीब
in_hindi.meaning: लरीब का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति अच्छाई की ओर झुकता है

in_pashto.name: لريب
in_pashto.meaning: لريب د معنی داړی چا ته چې د خير طرف ميلان لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: لريب د عربي نوم دی چې د معنی يې دادی چا ته چې د خير طرف ميلان لري او د هغه پيروي کوي. دا نوم د اسلامي دود په کې يو ښه او ستايل شوي معنی څرګندوي، کوم چې د خير کار کولو او د حق لارې پر چللو دلالة کوي.

in_english.name: Lareeb
in_english.meaning: One who inclines towards good and follows it
in_english.long_meaning: Lareeb is an Arabic name derived from the verb 'larab', meaning to incline towards good and follow it. This name holds a beautiful and commendable meaning in Islamic tradition, signifying one who tends to do good deeds and walk on the path of righteousness. The name Lareeb has its roots in Arabic etymology, specifically from the root 'L-R-B', which connotes the idea of inclining or leaning towards something. In the context of Islamic culture and Quranic teachings, the name Lareeb reflects a positive and virtuous personality trait, encouraging the bearer to follow the right path and engage in good actions.
